About 450 ready-made HyperFrames blocks and components installed as editable source - transitions, overlays, titles, kinetic type, captions, charts, map overlays, 3D, camera moves. This is a source-based walkthrough. Commands are displayed for you to review; this pipeline does not execute the skill.
npx hyperframes catalog npx hyperframes add Wiring

Open the pinned README and check the command. Run it from the project where you want to use the skill. In the installer, select only hyperframes-registry. This review covers skills/hyperframes-registry. npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes
Search is local and sends nothing. The default words tier only finds items that reuse your words; --on-device ranks by meaning after a one-time ~33 MB download.

Block: installs to compositions/<name>.html. Mount it with data-composition-src, data-composition-id matching the block's own id, data-start and the data-duration you need; the snippet add prints is the starting point.
Component: installs to compositions/components/<name>.html. Copy its markup, <style> and script into your scene, and follow its comment block if it hooks into your timeline.
